description_zh: 一辆低速行驶的车辆（Dodge Challenger，ego）试图从右侧绕过停在红灯前的静止车辆（WeRide AV，v2），因横向距离不足擦碰到v2的右后保险杠。

source_snippets: Our Autonomous vehicle (car 1) was in conventional mode stopped at the traffic light on Embarcadero and Washington.
A black color Dodge Challenger (car 2) attempted to bypass our car (car 1) from the rear and in doing so hit our car (car 1) right side rear bumper.
At the time of collision our AV (Car 1) was stopped traveling 0 mph and the Dodge Challenger (car 2) was traveling less than 5 mph.
evidence.reason: Ego selected as the moving Dodge Challenger that attempted to bypass a stopped vehicle, making it the test-worthy participant. NPC is the stopped AV, placed in adjacent left position with minimal lateral clearance to simulate the bypass attempt collision.
